boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Northern Iowa
boards.description: Ten currently documented Cedar Falls food stops with late evening or overnight availability; confirm hours before heading out.

cards.title: Taco Bell on University Avenue
cards.subtitle: 6023 University Avenue, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late option; the location lists overnight service every day, with later closing on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A University Avenue stop with the latest documented hours in Cedar Falls.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 4 AM Sunday through Wednesday and 5 AM Thursday through Saturday at 6023 University Avenue.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 6023 University Avenue, Cedar Falls
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 4 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 5 AM Thursday–Saturday; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Domino's on College Street
cards.subtitle: 2024 College Street, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order before leaving; the official location page currently shows this College Street store open until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A College Street pizza option with documented 2 AM availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists its 2024 College Street Cedar Falls location as open until 2 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 2024 College St. — Cedar Falls
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently displays “Open Today Until 2:00 AM”; check the ordering page for day-specific availability.

cards.title: Papa Johns on West 1st
cards.subtitle: 1322 W 1st St, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Choose delivery or carryout and check the day first; delivery runs later than carryout on Friday and Saturday at this West 1st Street store.
cards.short_summary: Pizza delivery listed until 2 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery until 2 AM Friday and Saturday and carryout until 1:30 AM at 1322 W 1st St.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza W 1st St — Cedar Falls
cards.access_notes: Delivery is listed until 2 AM Friday–Saturday; carryout is listed until 1:30 AM those nights and midnight other days.

cards.title: Tony's LaPizzeria
cards.subtitle: 407 Main Street, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Plan this for Friday or Saturday and confirm before going; the downtown district lists 2 AM closing on both nights for this pizza restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza counter with Friday and Saturday 2 AM hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cedar Falls Downtown District lists Tony's LaPizzeria open until 2 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Cedar Falls Downtown District — Tony's LaPizzeria
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Friday 4 PM–2 AM and Saturday 11:30 AM–2 AM; closed Monday and Tuesday.

cards.title: Pancheros on University Avenue
cards.subtitle: 6421 University Avenue, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Use the University Avenue store for a late burrito, bowl, taco, salad, or quesadilla; its official location page posts midnight and 2 AM closing times.
cards.short_summary: A burrito stop with midnight hours most nights and 2 AM late-week service.
cards.evidence_claim: Pancheros lists its Cedar Falls location open until midnight Sunday through Wednesday and until 2 AM Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Store hours are listed as 10:30 AM–midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 10:30 AM–2 AM Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on University Avenue
cards.subtitle: 6719 University Ave, Suite 3, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Order delivery or carryout from this University Avenue shop; the official location listing shows midnight closing most days and 1 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A late University Avenue pizza option with 1 AM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists restaurant hours until midnight Monday through Thursday and until 1 AM Friday and Saturday at 6719 University Ave.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 6719 University Ave, Cedar Falls
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 9 AM–midnight Monday–Thursday and 9 AM–1 AM Friday–Saturday; verify Sunday hours when ordering.

cards.title: Raising Cane's at Viking Plaza
cards.subtitle: 201 Viking Plaza Drive, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Pick drive-thru, curbside, or dine-in at the Viking Plaza location; it posts midnight closing Sunday through Thursday and 1 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Chicken-finger meals with a documented midnight-or-later schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's lists its 201 Viking Plaza Drive restaurant open until midnight Sunday through Thursday and 1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's — Vikings Plaza Dr, Cedar Falls
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and dine-in are both listed until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Zurys Taco Bar
cards.subtitle: 2214 College St, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Make Wednesday the late option here: the restaurant's own hours list service until midnight, while Thursday through Saturday close at 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: A College Street taco restaurant with a documented Wednesday midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Zurys Taco Bar lists Wednesday hours of 11 AM to midnight at 2214 College St.
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours list Wednesday until midnight, Thursday–Saturday until 11 PM, and earlier closes Sunday–Tuesday.

cards.title: Mulligans Brick Oven Grill
cards.subtitle: Cedar Falls, near 18th Street and Cedar Prairie Trail
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's food and carryout offerings for a late meal; its official page lists midnight closing Thursday through Saturday and carryout ordering.
cards.short_summary: Brick-oven pizza and food with a documented midnight weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: Mulligans lists hours until midnight Thursday through Saturday and offers carryout ordering.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11 AM–11 PM Sunday–Wednesday and 11 AM–midnight Thursday–Saturday; carryout is available.

cards.title: Casey's on University Avenue
cards.subtitle: 5226 University Ave, Cedar Falls
cards.notes: Use this convenience-store stop for pizza, sandwiches, wings, bakery items, or snacks; the store is listed open until 11 PM, with pickup until 10:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: A late convenience and prepared-food option on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey's lists its 5226 University Ave Cedar Falls store open daily from 5 AM to 11 PM, with pickup until 10:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Store hours are listed daily until 11 PM; pickup and delivery are listed daily until 10:30 PM.
